name: tiny-titans-keeper-companion
description: Read and update your own Tiny Titans keeper records through scoped account authorization.

interface.longDescription: Connect your own Tiny Titans account to read animal profiles and keeper histories, log feeding, weight, shed, behaviour and health records, create reminders, and undo eligible Companion actions. Tracker writes currently support snake records. An eligible Tiny Titans plan and individual account authorization are required.
